title: Lumpy!
text: Lumpy!. The colors are nice and vibrant, but this came with lumps all over it, like wall paper improperly applied.  Think there are quality control issues with these since another reviewer mentioned a similar issue.  A shame, but I sent it back.

product_metadata.title: Oriental Furniture Van Gogh's Starry Night Over the Rhone Trunk
features: Van Gogh's night sky lovingly reproduced on art-quality canvas
Convenient internal arm holds lid open
Durable wooden construction reinforced with riveted edges
description: This fetching chest features Van Gogh's 1888 work Starry Night Over the Rhone, an early painting through which he developed the distinctive style that culminated in the legendary Starry Night. Printed on high quality art-grade canvas, this trunk vividly captures the hues of the original painting, from the aquamarine sky to the russet gold of the gaslights reflected in the deep indigo waters. In the foreground, two well-dressed lovers stroll along beach beneath the pale starlight of the Big Dipper. Designed to last for years, the durable canvas is wrapped around a sturdy wooden frame and reinforced on the edges with matching faux leather and rivets. Lightweight and durable with two separate handles, this trunk is hassle-free to move, and you can rest easy knowing that your treasures are protected in it spacious interior by the soft fabric lining. Other conveniences include an inconspicuous interior arm that holds the lid when you need the trunk open, and a pair of external closures that keep it shut tight when you don't. This chest is equally suitable as a breathtaking addition to your home décor, or as a thoughtful gift for the art lover in your life.
